name: Mast
author: fazzledev
description: Tie yourself to the mast: block distracting sites, and make unblocking one cost a typed passage, a reason, and a relock.

barWidget.description: Per-site block switches. Unblocking means typing out a convincing passage and saying why, and the site blocks itself again after a while. Tracks every attempt. Hides itself when the helper is not installed.

schema.label: Sites
schema.description: Which sites get a switch. A site that is blocked or counting down to a relock shows regardless, so removing it here never hides or lifts a block.

schema.label: Switch passages
schema.description: Previous, next and shuffle on the unblock screen.

schema.label: Live typing speed
schema.description: Words per minute while typing a passage.

schema.label: Words needed to say why
schema.description: How many words the why answer needs before yes works. 0 makes it optional.

schema.label: Wait before yes
schema.description: Seconds after typing the passage before yes can be chosen.

schema.label: Unblock lasts (minutes)
schema.description: How long an unblock lasts before the site blocks itself again. The helper caps it at 60.

schema.label: Books
schema.description: Excerpts from public domain books that ship with Mast: Seneca, Marcus Aurelius, Epictetus, William James, Bennett, Thoreau and more.

schema.label: News
schema.description: Excerpts from researchers writing in The Conversation, shared under CC BY-ND 4.0.

schema.label: Green when all blocked
schema.description: The bar icon and switches turn green when every listed site is blocked.

schema.label: Week stats
schema.description: Unblock battles won and time unblocked, in the panel and the unblock screen.
